description: SINAPROC SIRED emergency damage assessment layer is published by SINAPROC. The SIRED layer defines emergency damage-assessment records and location attributes. Its stated coverage is Panama; the published national emergency-assessment service. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists ArcGIS REST JSON resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Only the layer schema was read; household-level records were not queried and actual coverage is unknown. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
